items.text: Before the floor vote on the budget bill, said it would be on course to pass once it added further reductions to national spending on public health coverage for working-age adults, which they said would curb waste and fraud.
Said the expanded premium subsidies for individually purchased insurance should end and subsidies return to their earlier, smaller level.
Called for comprehensive national reform of health care and health insurance, saying the existing law on individually purchased insurance had failed to make coverage affordable and accessible.
